findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be available upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, a sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed in use utensils to be resting on top of hot holding box. Discussed with PIC, utensils were pulled and placed through dish machine. Ensure any in use utensil is stored in a a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(C) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Two containers holding clean utensils were observed to contain crumbs other debris.  Discussed with PIC, who cleaned the tubs and utensils by putting them through the dish machine.  Ensure the tubs and utensils are protected or covered from debris to prevent contamination.

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Dish area to the right of the dish machine needs to be re-caulked.  The caulk present is cracked, separated, or missing from the wall.  Ensure area is caulked to prevent mold and food debris accumulation.

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
CFM’s have not completed allergen awareness training.  All CFM’s must complete an allergen awareness training course within 30 days of employment.  

410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec. 3.07. Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Ice machine baffle contained mold upon inspection.  Discussed with PIC, who corrected on site.  Ensure ice machine baffle is cleaned regularly to prevent mold accumulation.

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Dish area to the left of the dish machine needs to be re-caulked.  The caulk present is cracked and separated from the wall.  Ensure area is caulked to prevent mold and food debris accumulation.

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Ceiling vents in the kitchen were observed to have mold and condensation on the grates.  Condensation may drip on food and cause cross contamination.  PIC called maintenance same day to have cleaned.  Ensure all vents are cleaned and wiped free of mold and condensation regularly to prevent build up of mold and to prevent cross contamination.

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The knife holding rack in the kitchen was observed to have dust and possible food particles on the top where the knife slits are.  When clean knives are put in the knife slots with visible debris, the knives become contaminated.  PIC was informed and the inspector suggested the top of the knife holder be washed regularly to avoid cross contamination.  

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Fans are being used in the upstairs kitchen area.  The fans were observed to have an accumulation of dust on the front of the fan.  If fans are used in a food prep or serving area, ensure fans are regularly cleaned to prevent accumulation and possibly cause cross contamination.  PIC was informed.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A mop was observed in the dish area stored mop head down on the floor.  Ensure mops are stored in a position that allows them to air dry properly.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
